title: Committee of Supply – Total Sums for Main Estimates, Development Estimates and Resolutions
what_it_is: Committee of Supply – Total Sums for Main Estimates, Development Estimates and Resolutions

sections.label: Sitting suspended for extended break
sections.summary: The Speaker reminds Members to return for the Supply Bill and Supplementary Supply Bill, suspends the Sitting for an extended break, and will take the Chair at 3.55 pm.

sentences.speaker: Mr Speaker
sentences.text: Do remember to come back for the Supply Bill and the Supplementary Supply Bill.

sentences.speaker: Mr Speaker
sentences.text: I suspend the Sitting and, in honour of the women here today, on this special day, we will have an extended break.

sentences.speaker: Mr Speaker
sentences.text: I will take the Chair at 3.55 pm.
